terms.fighter_state: Opponent-independent point-in-time summary of one fighter built only from information available before prediction_as_of.
terms.matchup_interaction: Deterministic interaction of two already-built point-in-time fighter states and/or known pre-fight context.
terms.context: Known pre-fight information attached to a fighter or target bout without using post-fight outcomes.
terms.target: Training-only post-fight outcome or label; never a predictor for the same fight.
terms.predictor: Pre-fight value eligible for a model consumer under the feature contract.
terms.eligible_observation: Historical observation that satisfies identity, point-in-time, source-semantic, and concept-specific eligibility rules.
terms.support: The auditable amount and unit of personal/history evidence contributing to an estimate.
terms.exposure: The denominator/opportunity domain over which an event count, rate, share, or probability is defined.
terms.elapsed_exposure: Verified elapsed fight/round time admitted only through an approved ruleset/interpretation source.
terms.generic_control: Canonical fighter_round_stats.control_sec; generic control time only.
terms.top_position: Exact or explicitly bounded time in top position; not synonymous with generic control.
terms.ground_control: Control occurring in a ground-state semantic domain; must not be inferred from generic control unless DATA explicitly supports it.
terms.clinch_control: Control occurring in a clinch-state semantic domain; currently not exact-duration canonical evidence.
terms.positional_environment: Distance/clinch/ground environment evidence; current FightMetric position data are quantized interval buckets, not exact duration.
terms.attempt_composition: Share vector over mutually exclusive attempt/event categories.
terms.rate: Numerator divided by an explicit exposure denominator with defined zero/missing behavior.
terms.share: Part-to-whole ratio over an explicitly defined compatible denominator.
terms.probability: Bounded event likelihood defined over explicit attempts/opportunities.
terms.prior: Population estimate constructed point-in-time and used only under the declared shrinkage policy.
terms.shrinkage: Mechanical combination of personal sufficient statistics with an eligible population prior.
terms.opponent_adjustment: Historical quality adjustment using opponents' states as they existed strictly before those historical contests.
terms.canonical: DATA-layer semantic authority approved by the frozen canonical contract.
terms.derived: Deterministic value computed from canonical facts or shared feature concepts.
terms.proxy: Approximation explicitly marked as not equivalent to the desired semantic.
terms.research_only: Concept retained for human/research work and not eligible for production predictor materialization.
terms.deferred: Defined concept whose implementation/methodology is intentionally postponed.
terms.unsupported: Desired semantic that current canonical data cannot represent safely.
terms.materialized: Concrete output column/value emitted from a feature concept plus approved variant specification.
terms.consumer: Shared model, component, simulator, or research surface that selects feature IDs/tags without redefining semantics.
terms.historical_replay: Point-in-time regeneration of historical feature artifacts under a specific contract/methodology identity.
terms.artifact: Persisted predictor/training output carrying sufficient manifest metadata for future interpretation.
terms.contract_version: Version of the overall shared FEATURES semantic contract.
terms.methodology_version: Version of the transformation/calculation for a specific durable feature identity.

forbidden_aliases.must_mean: share of significant-strike attempts/lands classified as ground environment
forbidden_meanings: percentage of elapsed time spent on the ground

forbidden_aliases.must_mean: exact duration only when DATA semantics explicitly support it
forbidden_meanings: FightMetric whole-minute bucket lower/upper bounds treated as exact seconds
